description: This is a modern, high-backed armchair with a matching ottoman. The chair features a tufted design on the backrest and seat, giving it a plush and comfortable appearance. It has padded armrests and a supportive headrest. The entire set is upholstered in a vibrant orange material, likely leather or a high-quality faux leather, and rests on a sleek black base with swivel capabilities. The ottoman shares the same tufted design and color, serving as a footrest to complement the chair. The overall design is contemporary and stylish, intended for relaxation and comfort.
